title: Security Overview
description: One-glance security posture: host runtime (Falco), network IDS (Suricata), IP reputation and bans (CrowdSec), HIDS (Wazuh), DNS filtering (AdGuard) and ingress probes. Counts are the last 24 hours.

options.content:
Security Overview
Falco · Suricata · CrowdSec · Wazuh · AdGuard · Traefik
FalcoSuricataCrowdSecWazuhAdGuardTraefik accessAlerts

panels.title: Falco critical+
panels.description: Falco events at Critical, Alert or Emergency priority.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({task="falco", node=~".+"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" | priority=~"Emergency|Alert|Critical" [24h])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({task="falco", node=~".+"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" | priority=~"Error|Warning" [24h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Suricata severity 1
panels.description: All severity 1 alerts. The alert rule ignores ET P2P (Transmission) and ET INFO signatures.

panels.title: CrowdSec active decisions
panels.description: Decisions (bans) currently enforced, local and community blocklist.

panels.title: CrowdSec bans
panels.description: New local ban decisions in the CrowdSec log.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({task="crowdsec"} |~ "ban on [Ii]p" | regexp `\) (?P<scenario>.+?) by ip (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` [24h])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({task=~"$wazuh_task"} | json | __error__="" | rule_level!="" | rule_level >= 12 [24h])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({task=~"$wazuh_task"} | json | __error__="" | rule_level!="" | rule_level >= 7 | rule_level < 12 [24h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: AdGuard blocked
panels.description: Share of DNS queries blocked by filtering (AdGuard's own window).

panels.title: Traefik path probes
panels.description: Requests for /wp-admin, /.env, /.git, phpMyAdmin and similar scanner paths.

panels.title: Sensors up
panels.description: Prometheus targets for Falco (one per node), CrowdSec and AdGuard (one per node).

panels.title: Suricata capture drops
panels.description: Kernel packet drops over the last hour.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(sum_over_time({task="suricata"} |= `"event_type":"stats"` | json d="stats.capture.kernel_drops_delta" | unwrap d | __error__="" [1h])) / sum(sum_over_time({task="suricata"} |= `"event_type":"stats"` | json p="stats.capture.kernel_packets_delta" | unwrap p | __error__="" [1h]))
sum by (priority) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~".+"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: When things happen (7 days)
panels.description: Falco warning+, Suricata severity 1-2, CrowdSec bans and Wazuh level 7+ per hour over the last week.

targets.expr: sum by (scenario) (count_over_time({task="crowdsec"} |~ "ban on [Ii]p" | regexp `\) (?P<scenario>.+?) by ip (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` [$__auto]))
topk(15, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({task="crowdsec"} |~ "ban on [Ii]p" | regexp `\) (?P<scenario>.+?) by ip (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` [24h])))
topk(15, sum by (rule, priority) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~".+"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" [24h])))

panels.title: Security alerts
panels.description: Firing and pending Grafana alerts, newest first.
